plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 客户端插件：把设置入口放到侧边栏底部，一键打开设置页。 / A DSH client plugin that puts a settings button at the bottom of the sidebar.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidebar-settings

[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![verify](https://github.com/linguiyii/dsh-sidebar-settings/actions/workflows/verify.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/linguiyii/dsh-sidebar-settings/actions/workflows/verify.yml)

把 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的设置入口从「账号菜单 → 设置」的二级菜单里提出来，直接放到**侧边栏底部**：
点一下就打开设置面板，不必再先点账号头像。

A DeepSeek Harness **client plugin**: one settings button at the bottom of the sidebar, one click to the
settings panel — no more avatar menu → 设置.

![侧边栏底部的设置按钮](docs/sidebar-button.png)

> 图里两行「⚙ 设置」：上面一行是本插件新增的 `sidebar.footer.action` 座位，下面一行是外壳原生的
> `sidebar.settings` 入口（本插件不删除它）。

![点击后打开设置面板](docs/settings-panel.png)

> 截图展示的是设置面板的「添加 API Key」引导态；侧栏内容已做模糊处理。

侧边栏折叠成图标栏（rail）时只显示齿轮：

![折叠态下的图标按钮](docs/rail.png)

> 第一行是本插件渲染的图标按钮，第二行是原生入口。

`sidebar-button.png` 与 `settings-panel.png` 由仓库里的 CDP 探测脚本产出（见「开发」）；折叠态截图是在
同一个临时 profile 里手工折叠侧边栏后截取的。

## 前置条件

- **Node.js ≥ 22**（`package.json` 的 `engines`，构建与安装脚本都要求）。
- **DeepSeek Harness 桌面端**：已在 0.1.5-rc.2 的 Web UI 上做过端到端验证。
- 安装需要写权限：`<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>` 目录（Windows 默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`）。
- 仅 e2e 探测额外需要：`dsh` CLI + Chrome/Edge（`--headless=new --remote-debugging-port=<port>`）。

## 安装

先克隆，再把这个仓库装进 DSH profile（Windows 桌面端默认 profile 为 `desktop`）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/linguiyii/dsh-sidebar-settings
cd dsh-sidebar-settings

node scripts/install-desktop.mjs --dry-run   # 先看要改什么
node scripts/install-desktop.mjs             # 真正写入
```

脚本只做三件事，并把改动过的文件各备份一份为 `<file>.dsh-sidebar-settings.bak`：

1. 在 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-sidebar-settings` 建立指向本仓库的 junction
   （非 Windows 平台用目录符号链接）；
2. 在 profile 的 `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 里记录 `"dsh-sidebar-settings": "link:<本仓库路径>"`；
3. 把 `dsh-sidebar-settings` 追加到 `dsh.profile.bundles`（host 启动时按这个列表加载 profile 层）。

> **为什么不用 `dsh plugin add`**：`dsh plugin --profile desktop ...` 会被拒绝 ——
> `error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`
> （`desktop` profile 由桌面应用独占管理）。所以这里用脚本完成同样的三处改动。

安装后**重启 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端**（客户端 bundle 在启动时装配）。
卸载：`node scripts/install-desktop.mjs --uninstall` —— 删除链接、`dependencies` 条目与
`dsh.profile.bundles` 条目；已经不存在的那几项会跳过。

其他 profile / 其他 DSH_HOME：

```powershell
$env:DSH_HOME = "C:\path\to\.dsh"; node scripts/install-desktop.mjs --profile web
```

## 使用

- 侧边栏底部多出一行「⚙ 设置」，点一下即打开设置面板；
- 侧边栏折叠成图标栏（rail）时只显示齿轮图标，鼠标悬停提示「打开设置 (Ctrl+,)」；
- 原有入口都保留：账号菜单里的「设置」、快捷键 `Ctrl+,`（Windows/macOS 桌面端）照常可用。

## 实现方式

插件只做两件事：注册一个座位、打开一个面板。

**1. 按钮放在哪** —— `sidebar.footer.action`（`list` 槽，多插件可共存，按 `order` 排序）。
它在侧边栏 footer 的 `footerActions` 区，紧贴在最底部的 `sidebar.settings` 行（账号菜单行）之上；
侧边栏折叠时 `wide: false`，我们渲染成居中的图标按钮。样式以一个带 `data-plugin` 标记的
`<style>` 注入（客户端模块加载器会接管它，卸载/热更新时自动移除），配色走 `--dsw-*` 主题变量。

**2. 怎么打开设置** —— 两条路径，先精确后兜底：

- **store 路径**（较新的外壳）：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-general` 注册 `sidebar.settings`
  时把设置外壳的 store 挂在该槽的 entry 上（`store.create()` 返回同一份 shell 实例）。
  我们通过 `ctx.slots.entries("sidebar.settings")` 取回它并调用 `actions.open()` —— 与原生齿轮按钮、
  `Ctrl+,` 命令、账号菜单里的「设置」走的是同一个 action。
- **DOM 兜底**（较旧的外壳，store 未公开）：直接点侧边栏设置行自己的控件 ——
  旧外壳那里是原生齿轮按钮（点一次就开）；新外壳那里是账号菜单触发器，于是再等一帧点掉菜单里的
  「设置 / Settings」项。全部基于 `[data-slot="..."]` 与 `aria-haspopup` 语义选择器，不依赖哈希后的
  CSS module 类名。

不靠合成键盘事件：桌面端的 `Ctrl+,` 由宿主注册和处理，页面里派发 `keydown` 并不会打开设置。
所以本插件直接调用设置外壳的 action（store 路径），或者点真实控件（DOM 兜底）。

## 开发

仓库零依赖，不需要打包器：`src/client.js` 直接以「客户端模块工厂函数体」的形式书写（CommonJS，
只 `require` 外壳提供的平台模块），构建脚本只做字符串包装 + 纯度和校验。

```powershell
node scripts/build.mjs     # src/client.js -> lib/client.js（window.__ModuleLoader__.load 包装）
node scripts/verify.mjs    # 契约测试：VM 里加载 bundle，验证注册、渲染、四条打开/兜底路径
```

`lib/client.js` 是提交进仓库的构建产物，CI 会重跑构建并用 `git diff --exit-code -- lib/client.js`
确认它和 `src/client.js` 同步。

端到端验证（可选，需要一个已装插件的 Web 实例 + 带调试端口的 Chrome/Edge）：

```powershell
# 1) 起一个临时 profile 的 Web 实例（--from-default-profile 从内置模板初始化，避免影响正在用的桌面端）
$env:DSH_HOME = "$env:TEMP\dsh-verify"
dsh --profile verify --from-default-profile web --port 4779 --no-open
# 2) Chrome 打开 http://127.0.0.1:4779/?token=... 并带上 --headless=new --remote-debugging-port=9333
node scripts/probe-ui.mjs --cdp 9333 --shot lib/probe.png
```

`probe-ui.mjs` 会等到按钮出现、打印它的标签/位置、截侧栏底部特写（`<shot>-sidebar.png`），点击按钮后
确认设置面板打开并截整窗（`<shot>`），否则退出码 1。折叠态（rail）截图不在脚本里，需要手工折叠
侧边栏后另拍。

## 目录

```
cordis.patch.yml        profile 层 patch：插入插件行
lib/index.js            host 侧加载行（本插件不占 host 服务，apply 为空）
lib/client.js           构建产物：浏览器端 bundle（已提交，安装时无需构建）
src/client.js           浏览器端源码（factory body 形式）
scripts/build.mjs       无依赖构建：包装 + require 纯度闸门
scripts/verify.mjs      Node 内契约测试
scripts/install-desktop.mjs  把本仓库装进/卸出 DSH profile
scripts/probe-ui.mjs    CDP 端到端探测（渲染 + 点击 + 截图）
.github/workflows/verify.yml  CI：build → 构建产物漂移检查 → 契约测试
docs/                   验证截图
LICENSE                 MIT
```

## 已知限制

- **账号菜单里的「设置」不会被删掉**：那一项由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account`
  的内部组件渲染，没有公开的扩展点可以移除它；本插件只是在你更顺手的位置补一个直达入口。
- 需要**重启桌面端**后生效（客户端 bundle 在启动时装配）。
- 侧边栏折叠时，`sidebar.footer.action` 座位只给 `wide`，无法感知当前面板是否已打开，按钮不做开/关状态高亮。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DSH 能力管家：说功能就能用上装过的插件 —— 能力路由（按任务匹配到该调的工具名）、主动体检（版本落后 / 运行时故障 / 基线通过率）、利用率盘点（哪些能力从没用上）。npm: dsh-skill-auditor
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-auditor

**你的 DSH 装了 20 个插件，但你真的用上了吗？**

这个工具回答三个问题——**都在对话里，不用你敲命令**：

---

## 1. 「那个查余额的叫啥来着？」

你装了插件，但忘了名字。

> 你：帮我查下余额
>
> 它：（查已装插件）你装的是 `dsh-whale-widget`，直接说「用鲸鱼挂件看余额」就行

不用记插件名，也不用知道它暴露了什么工具。**说功能就行**。

---

## 2. 「这些插件还好用吗？」

插件会坏、会过时，但通常没人告诉你。

装好后**自动体检**（宿主启动 8 秒后跑一次，不阻塞你），结论写在一个文件里：

```
🔴 建议先修（1）
  browser-skill   装是装上了，但依赖的 bsk 命令行找不到

⬆️ 建议升级（1）
  dshmarket       1.66.5 → 1.66.42（落后 37 个版本）

✅ 正常（3）
```

它区分三种事：**跑不起来**（修环境）、**版本落后**（升级）、**能力退化**（模型换代后重跑用例测出来的）。

第三件是这东西的核心——**换模型后，同一批用例重跑，通过率掉超过 20pp 才算退化**。不是「感觉变笨了」，是有数据。

---

## 3. 「我这插件是不是只用了个皮毛？」

装了插件，但只用了最显眼那个按钮。

```
能力利用盘点 · 14 个工具
已用 1 / 14    未动用 13

💡 还在睡觉的 13 个：
  · hindsight_capture_initiative  —— 能把重要讨论存成可检索的记忆
  · bsk_tabs                      —— 多标签页操作，批量对比页面用得上
  · bsk_session                   —— 管理多个浏览器会话
```

每个没用上的工具都告诉你**它是干什么的、什么场景该用**。数据来源是插件自己的源码——工具名和描述都是扫出来的，不靠插件作者自觉。

---

## 装

**方式一：当 DSH 插件用**（推荐，能力全开）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skill-auditor
```

装完重启 DSH，8 秒后自动体检。

**方式二：当普通 CLI 用**

```bash
npm i -g dsh-skill-auditor
dsh-skill-auditor            # 裸跑 = 直接出体检结论
```

---

## 为什么值得信

这个工具自己就反对「凭感觉下结论」：

- **不猜**：判不出来就说「判不出来」。模型版本推不到时它拒绝写戳，而不是写个假的。
- **不伪造**：插件没有可调用工具时，它说「这是纯 UI 插件，让用户在界面里用」，不会假装能调。
- **数据说话**：能力退化要「指纹没变 + 通过率掉 ≥20pp + 方向一致」三条同时成立。只掉一点或者有升有降，都只标「观察」，不叫退化。
- **零依赖、纯本地**：只用 Python 标准库。判定、体检、盘点全在你机器上跑，除了可选的插件市场查询，不联网。
- **不自动改任何东西**：不自动卸载、不自动升级、不改你的配置。只报告。

---

## 它怎么做到「说功能就能用」

三步，全在本地：

1. **扫**——读插件源码，提取它注册了哪些工具、每个工具干什么
2. **路由**——把用户的话（「帮我记住这个」）映射到功能域（记忆），再映射到具体插件和工具名
3. **交付**——把工具名交给模型，模型直接调用

支持 28 个计算机方向的功能域（数据库、部署、测试、爬虫、鉴权、监控、CI…），中文说法和英文说法都认。

---

## 支持的宿主

| 宿主 | 评什么 | 目录 |
|---|---|---|
| **DSH** | 插件 | `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>` |
| WorkBuddy | skill | `~/.workbuddy-ai/skills` |
| Claude Code | skill | `~/.claude/skills` |
| 通用 | 任意 | `--root` 指定 |

同一套引擎，每个宿主只是一个适配器（知道资产在哪、清单长什么样）。

---

## 30 秒看效果（不碰你的数据）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Zhr65/dsh-skill-auditor.git && cd dsh-skill-auditor
python demo.py
```

它在 `demo/` 沙盒里造 6 个假 skill，真跑一遍完整流程：扫描 → 建基线 → 模拟模型换代 → 重跑 → 判定谁退化了。全程不读也不写你的任何真实数据。

---

## 命令附录

<details>
<summary>日常就三条（点开看）</summary>

```bash
dsh-skill-auditor              # 体检（裸跑就是这个）
dsh-skill-auditor insights     # 能力利用盘点
dsh-skill-auditor find "记忆"  # 按功能找插件
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>全部命令（开发者向）</summary>

```bash
python scripts/console.py can "做个PPT"      # 这件事能不能做
python scripts/console.py find "查余额"       # 按功能找资产
python scripts/console.py insights           # 能力利用盘点
python scripts/console.py audit              # 体检（版本+运行时+基线）
python scripts/console.py status             # 折旧表
python scripts/console.py recommend          # 推荐/淘汰面板（六档）
python scripts/console.py check              # 模型换代了吗
python scripts/console.py probe              # 读日志找运行时故障
python scripts/console.py scan               # 重新扫描资产
python scripts/console.py suggest --need "X" # 缺能力时推荐
```

所有命令加 `--host <宿主>` 指定评哪个宿主，`--out <dir>` 换数据目录。

**退出码可编程**：`0` 正常 / `2` 有问题或需要重跑 / `3` 缺能力。

</details>

<details>
<summary>建模基线（想让判定更准才需要）</summary>

装完就能用，基线是可选的加强项。想跑：

```bash
python scripts/baseline.py --from-seed --host deepseek --model <当前模型>
python scripts/console.py --host deepseek scan
```

`seed/` 是随包分发的公共用例库（35 条，覆盖 10 个常见资产），`--from-seed` 只取你真实装了的那些，不凑数。

模型升级后重跑一遍，就能看到「哪些资产在新模型上退化了」。

</details>

<details>
<summary>数据都在哪</summary>

全部本地，个人数据不进仓库、不进包：

| 文件 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `registry.<host>.json` | 资产清单 + 指纹 + 工具名 |
| `baseline-results.json` | 判定记录 |
| `model-version.json` | 当前模型戳 |
| `last-audit.txt` | 最近一次体检报告 |

安装器复制到其他宿主时**只带代码和文档**，不搬注册表、基线、个人用例。

</details>

<details>
<summary>项目结构</summary>

```
scripts/      引擎（8 个脚本，纯标准库）
npm/          DSH 插件 + npm 包（9 个工具）
seed/         公共用例库（随包分发）
golden/       你自己的用例（不上传）
catalog/      市场收录条目
demo.py       沙盒演示
```

</details>

---

## 开发

```bash
python scripts/test_engine.py    # 95 项引擎测试
python demo.py                   # 端到端演示
cd npm && npm test               # 插件冒烟 + 打包安装全链路
```

MIT License。

---

<sub>这个 README 的原则：**先讲你能得到什么，再讲怎么敲**。看不明白哪段，是写的人的问题，不是你的问题。</sub>

plugins.description: The official DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI, unmodified, running on HarmonyOS 2in1 / tablet inside the system ArkWeb — with the dsh Host on a real Node.js runtime embedded in the same process. No Electron, no bundled Chromium, no ArkUI rewrite of the Web UI.
plugins.readme_text:
[中文](./README_zh.md) | English # DSH Desktop · HarmonyOS Edition > The **official DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI, unmodified**, running on HarmonyOS 2in1 / tablet inside the system **ArkWeb** — with the dsh Host on a **real Node.js runtime embedded in the same process**. No Electron, no bundled Chromium, no ArkUI rewrite.

## What you get - **The same dsh you already know** — sessions, tools, plugins, settings, themes. The frontend is upstream, untouched; the agent host runs locally, so there is no relay, no CORS, no account gate. - **Nothing to render with** — the system WebView draws the UI, so the package ships only the agent runtime (≈42 MB payload) instead of a browser engine. The HAP is ≈88 MB. - **Installs without restricted permissions** — the default build is JIT-free (`compat`), so side-loading needs no ACL-bound permission. A `jit` variant exists for devices granted the writable-code-memory permission. - **Zero upstream changes** — HarmonyOS differences live in an `ohos` profile, one bundle layer, seam plugins and six audited shims. Upgrading dsh means re-running the pipeline, not re-doing patches. - **Branded as this product** — own icon, name and window title; the upstream preview notice and the DeepSeek first-run dialog no longer open by themselves (both remain reachable in Settings). ## Two HarmonyOS editions HarmonyOS gets **two independent editions** with the same shell architecture, the same unmodified Web UI and the same data plane; the difference is **which runtime provides Node**: | | **HarmonyOS Edition** (this repo) | **Electron on HarmonyOS Edition** ([`dsh-desktop-hos`](../dsh-desktop-hos)) | |---|---|---| | Renderer | The system **ArkWeb** — nothing bundled | Chromium, shipped inside Electron 37 | | Node.js | `libnode.so` started in the app's own process (v24.2.0) | Inside the Electron runtime (Node 22.17) | | Runtime plumbing | [`@fellow99/node-bridge`](https://ohpm.openharmony.cn/#/cn/detail/@fellow99%2Fnode-bridge) + [`@fellow99/node-runtime`](https://ohpm.openharmony.cn/#/cn/detail/@fellow99%2Fnode-runtime) (ohpm) | [`harmonypc-electron`](../harmonypc-electron) | | Upstream dsh patches | **0** — profile + bundle layer + audited shims | 13 source patches | | Install requirement | none (JIT-free default) | JIT restricted permission (ACL) | | Package size | ≈88 MB | Electron-sized (hundreds of MB) | | Maturity | 0.2.1 — device-verified on HarmonyOS 6.1.0.135 (API 24) | 0.2.1 — device-verified (0.2.0 baseline) | Neither replaces the other: the Electron edition buys maximum desktop fidelity at the cost of a bundled Chromium and JIT; this edition buys a small payload and a permission-free install at the cost of covering platform gaps in the shim layer. ## Capabilities at a glance | Area | State | |---|---| | dsh Web UI, sessions, tools, skills, subagents | ✅ works as upstream | | File read / write / edit, image attachments | ✅ | | Workspace picker with Documents & Downloads (grant → read/write) | ✅ | | Git (21 tools, pure JS, no `git` binary needed) | ✅ | | Local plugins loaded from the profile, own branding | ✅ | | Command execution (`bash`) | ⚠️ executor ships; a path-resolution fix is pending | | Content search (`grep` / `glob`) | ⚠️ needs a pure-JS backend (no `ripgrep` binary on arm64) | | Delete / move / copy / chmod | ⚠️ upstream `ctx.fs` has no such primitives yet | | Plugin marketplace, tray icon, window-state memory | — not in this edition | The complete matrix — every capability, both editions side by side, with root causes — is [`docs/鸿蒙环境能力清单-0.2.1.md`](docs/鸿蒙环境能力清单-0.2.1.md). ## Status `0.2.1` (`versionCode` 201) — **runs on device**. Verified on HarmonyOS 6.1.0.135 (API 24, 2in1): installs with zero ACLs, the payload self-extracts and reports `ready`, all shims install, `node:sqlite`/FTS5 available, text and image conversations, workspace picker across the three roots, git clone (public and intranet), and the branded window (checked through the WebView debugger). Known gaps and their fix points are listed in the capability inventory above. ## Build Prerequisites: DevEco **Command Line Tools** (SDK API 24) and the sibling submodule `../deepseek-harness`. The Node runtime is pulled from the OpenHarmony ohpm central repository: [`@fellow99/node-bridge`](https://ohpm.openharmony.cn/#/cn/detail/@fellow99%2Fnode-bridge) (API + NAPI bootstrap) and [`@fellow99/node-runtime@24.2.0`](https://ohpm.openharmony.cn/#/cn/detail/@fellow99%2Fnode-runtime) (the `libnode.so` engine, SHA-256-locked by the bundled `runtime.lock.json`). ```bash node scripts/assemble-payload.mjs --deploy --apply # ① materialize the dsh runtime bash scripts/build-hap.sh # ② ohpm install → payload archive + HAP build/sign hdc app install -r entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap ``` `OHOS_CLT` overrides the Command Line Tools root; `node scripts/verify-upstream.mjs` proves the upstream pin is intact (tag, clean tree, patch ids, brand/onboarding gates). ## Docs | Document | What it answers | |---|---| | [Capability inventory 0.2.1](docs/鸿蒙环境能力清单-0.2.1.md) | What works, what does not, and how this compares to the Electron edition | | [Engineering plan](docs/000-工程规划.md) | Why this architecture, what was rejected, and the shim whitelist | | [On-device notes](docs/010-真机调试记录.md) | What broke on the device and how it was diagnosed | | [JIT and ACL](docs/ACL配置.md) · [JIT-less decision](docs/109-jitless-方案决策.md) | The two runtime forms and what each costs | | [Specifications](specs/README.md) | 11 spec modules (101–109, 204, 205) with plans and gates | ## Related - [`dsh-desktop`](../dsh-desktop) — Electron shell for Windows / Linux / macOS - [`dsh-desktop-hos`](../dsh-desktop-hos) — Electron on HarmonyOS Edition - [`@fellow99/node-bridge`](https://ohpm.openharmony.cn/#/cn/detail/@fellow99%2Fnode-bridge) / [`@fellow99/node-runtime`](https://ohpm.openharmony.cn/#/cn/detail/@fellow99%2Fnode-runtime) — the ohpm packages that embed Node (`node::Start`) in-process - [`deepseek-harness`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — the wrapped agent host ## License [MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin: global search across session content, ordered by content time.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-search

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that searches the
**content** of every session — not just session titles — and orders hits by the **time of the
matched record**, newest first.

It adds a first-class search destination to the sidebar (a panel icon beside *Plugins* and
*Schedules*, plus a full-width results page) and a `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F` shortcut. Clicking a hit
opens its session.

```
┌─ sidebar ─┐  ┌─ main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Plugins  │  │  Search session content                                    │
│ ▸ Search  │  │  [ 会话                                            ]        │
│  Schedules│  │  All · My prompts · Replies · Tool output   ☐ subagents    │
│           │  │  43 hits · 8 sessions · 4 ms                               │
│           │  │ ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│           │  │ 2026-09-11 01:55   user   修改 FreeCAD MCP 服务端口         │
│           │  │   我在使用这个 mcp 服务[插件]，但是端口被占用了…            │
└───────────┘  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Why this plugin exists

Stock DSH can already *search* sessions — the sidebar search box is wired to a real
content-search pipeline:

```
WorkspaceBrowser → sessions.search(query) → ctx.remote.session.search
  → SessionController.search → ctx.sessionQuery.searchSessions(…)
```

It only ever finds titles because **three independent things** are true at once:

| # | Fact | Where |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | The content backend is **switched off** in the stock profile — `openAt: never`. The shipped comment says it plainly: *"the Web sidebar search matches titles and workspace names only."* | the `session-query-sqlite` row in `dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml` |
| 2 | That backend tokenizes with FTS5 `unicode61`, which treats **an entire CJK run as a single token**. Measured on a real machine: `光速太慢，星际文明无法成为整体` yields exactly two tokens, `光速太慢` and `星际文明无法成为整体` — so `MATCH '光速'` and `MATCH '星际'` both **return nothing**. The `trigram` tokenizer is no help either: it rejects 2-character queries. | verified locally against SQLite 3.53.4 |
| 3 | Even with the backend enabled, the wire shape is `{ items: [{ sessionId, snippet }] }` — **each hit's `time` is dropped at that layer**, and ranking is relevance-first (`time` is only a tie-breaker). | `dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js` |

So "order results by content time" is **not achievable through any shipped public remote**, and
for CJK content the shipped engine is the wrong tool regardless. This plugin therefore builds its
own index on the host: it incrementally parses every session transcript, keeps each record's text
together with **that record's own `time`**, matches by substring (correct for both CJK and Latin
text), and sorts by time. It needs **no profile configuration changes**.

---

## Where the search entry lives — and why

DSH's Web/desktop UI has **no global top bar** and **no global command palette** (`/` commands are
the composer's slash menu and are bound to the current session). Only three global seats are
available:

| Seat | Verdict |
|---|---|
| **`sidebar.panellist` icon + its matching `main` panel** | ✅ **Used here.** This is DSH's first-class "global panel" mechanism: the sidebar owns the button, the label and the selected state, and the list `id` maps directly to the `main` panel `key`. The shipped **Plugins** (order 0) and **Schedules** (order 10) panels work exactly this way; this plugin slots in between at order 5. `replaceRisk: none` — it cannot be clobbered by an upgrade. |
| `sidebar.footer.action` (next to Settings) + a `shell.overlay` dialog | ⭕ Viable alternative, better suited to a "spotlight" quick-search. Costs you hand-built overlay, focus and Escape handling, and leaves little room for snippets. |
| `sidebar.workspaces` (where the existing search box lives) | ❌ **Not used.** It is a `single` seat occupied wholesale by `ui-workspace`, with `replaceRisk: shadows-shipped-ui` — taking it means replacing the entire shipped session browser and breaking on the next DSH release. |

A **`Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F`** shortcut (registered through `dsh-client-shortcuts`) selects the panel from
anywhere. It is bound on the **desktop profiles only** on purpose: on the Web profiles the shipped
`session.fork` (`dsh-client-ui-workspace`) already owns `KeyF + primary+shift`, and the shortcut
registry validates a definition's defaults across every *declared* profile, throwing
`Conflicting shortcut defaults` from whichever plugin registers second. See
[Compatibility](#compatibility) for what that cost once.

For **searching inside the session you are reading**, the entry point is the `list` seat
`conversation.session.header.utilities` — the right-aligned action row of the conversation header.
It is additive (`replaceRisk: none`, ids `open-in-app` / `schedule-catalog` /
`session-log-download` already sit there), always in reach, and needs no new global chrome. The
find bar and the result dialog share one `shell.overlay` entry — the frame-wide layer documented as
"the additive seat for a frame-wide surface of your own" — so they float above every column without
stealing one.

---

## Install

This package is a standard DSH **bundle** (`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client` in its manifest).
Install it with the plugin manager:

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target="<absolute path to this repo>"
```

That writes the package into the profile's `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles` and links it
into the profile's `node_modules`. You do **not** need to hand-edit the profile's `package.json` or
`cordis.patch.yml`.

Disable or remove it again:

```
plugin_manager action=set_bundle    target=dsh-session-search enabled=false
plugin_manager action=remove_bundle target=dsh-session-search
```

### Mounting it manually instead

Add a row to the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (the `name` may be a bare package specifier, a
path relative to the patch file, or an absolute path):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-search
      name: 'dsh-session-search'
```

> **A note on reloading.** The Harness loads plugin rows through Node's ESM loader, which caches
> both the resolved package entry and the module itself for the lifetime of the Host process.
> Re-enabling a row that previously failed re-runs the *cached* module, so a fix on disk is not
> observed until the app restarts — `dsh-hmr` can activate a **new** row, but it cannot swap a
> JavaScript module generation for an already-loaded package. `lib/entry.js` exists to work around
> this during development: it re-imports `lib/host.js` behind an mtime-keyed query, so host-side
> edits take effect on the next activation. In normal use it is simply the entry point.

---

## Usage

### Global search

1. Click the magnifier icon in the sidebar (between *Plugins* and *Schedules*), or press
   `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F`.
2. Type a query. Matching is **substring**, case-insensitive, and works for CJK (a 2-character
   query matches inside a longer run, which the shipped FTS5 engine cannot do).
3. Narrow the results with the chips — *All* / *My prompts* / *Replies* / *Tool output* — and the
   *Include subagent sessions* toggle (off by default; subagent sessions routinely outnumber your
   own). The **session scope picker** at the top lists only the sessions that actually matched the
   current query, with hit counts (`title (12)`), so scoping to one of them is one click; with no
   query it lists recent sessions.
4. Click any hit to open it **with its context**: the matched record plus four records before and
   after, the match highlighted and untruncated. Use previous/next to move between hits, and
   *Open session* to jump to the session itself.

### Find in the conversation (Ctrl/Cmd+F)

Press `Ctrl/Cmd+F`, or click the magnifier in the conversation header's right-aligned utilities.
A small floating bar appears, searches the transcript, paints **every match** and scrolls the
active one into view:

- `Enter` / `Shift+Enter`, or `‹ ›`, cycle matches; `Esc` closes and clears the highlights.
- The match counter s

plugins.description: DSH 插件：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Teamo 效果，支持通过 dsh plugin 命令安装。A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that adds Teamo effects.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-teamo-effort

DSH 插件：把用户选择的 **Teamo 模型强度**（`reasoning_effort`）注入发往
**TeamoRouter** 的模型请求。安装后在设置页多出一页「Teamo 模型强度」，用下拉菜单
选择 `Off / Low / Medium / High`；并在输入框右侧提供一个与 **dsh-effort-switcher 同款**
的折叠式强度控件：平时只显示 `Teamo 强度 · High`，点开才出现滑条。
下一次模型请求立即生效，无需重启。

## 与 dsh-effort-switcher 协作

两者分工明确，不会互相覆盖：

| 当前模型 | 谁控制强度 |
|---|---|
| 适配器公布了 `reasoning.efforts`（DeepSeek 官方模型等） | **输入框里的滑块**（dsh-effort-switcher / DSH 原生选择器）。`agent/request` 一旦发现提案已带 `reasoningEffort`，就原样返回，绝不覆盖 |
| 没有任何原生强度控制（TeamoRouter 现在的模型） | **本插件**：设置页 + 输入框右侧的 `Teamo 强度` 折叠控件（点开后拖动选 Off / Low / Medium / High） |

也就是说：有滑块的地方归滑块，没滑块的地方归本插件；同一时刻同一会话只有一个生效的
强度入口。折叠控件只在「当前模型命中本插件过滤条件、且没有原生滑块」时出现，其它情况
完全隐藏。设置页里也写明了这条优先级。

输入框控件的形态与 DeepSeek 官方模型完全一致（隐藏式）：composer 行里只有
`Teamo 强度 · High ▾` 这么一小段文本；点击（或键盘回车）才在它上方弹出面板，
面板里是与 switcher 同款的滑轨——26px 轨道、30px 圆形滑块、4 个刻度点、最高档渐变高亮，
以及当前档位的说明文字；点击面板外或按 `Esc` 收起。拖动时只更新本地草稿（滑块跟手），
松手（或方向键松开）才提交一个确定档位；提交后滑块先停在目标位置，等 Host 回传
新值时再对齐，写入失败会退回真实值。

## 行为

| 选择 | 发往 TeamoRouter 的请求 |
|---|---|
| `Off` | 不下发 `reasoning_effort`，走上游默认 |
| `Low` / `Medium` / `High` | JSON body 里写入 `reasoning_effort: "<档位>"` |

过滤条件（可选，留空表示全部）：

- `providers`：命中的 DSH provider 路由，默认 `["teamo"]`；
- `models`：命中的模型 id，默认空 = 该 provider 下的所有模型；
- `endpoints`：只有发往这些地址前缀的请求才会被改写，默认
  `["https://api.teamorouter.cn"]`，避免误注入到别的服务。

## 两层注入（为什么不是只改 `agent/request`）

`agent/request` 是决定点：它拿到本步真实的 `provider` / `model`，据此判断过滤条件，
并把结论交给外发层。但 DSH 会在任何 provider I/O 之前用**模型自身公布的能力**校验
`reasoningEffort`（`UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`）——TeamoRouter 目前按手工声明的
路由接入（`llm-pi-ai` 的 `models` 没有 `reasoningEfforts`），模型不公布任何档位，
直接把 `reasoningEffort` 写进冻结提案会让每一步请求失败。

因此：

1. 模型**公布**了该档位（例如以后给 Teamo 模型补上 `reasoningEfforts`，或把
   `deepseek-official` 也纳入过滤）→ 监听器返回
   `{ ...config, reasoningEffort: effort }`，由适配器序列化；
2. 模型**没有**公布档位 → 监听器只做决策与记账（并清掉路由无法兑现的残留
   `reasoningEffort`），真正的外发字段由 Host 半在 `fetch` 边界写入 TeamoRouter 的
   JSON body。这个包装只劫持「配置里的端点 + POST + body 里带命中的 `model` +
   body 里尚未出现该字段」的请求，其余请求原样透传，插件卸载时自动还原。

`agent/request` 交给监听器的提案是 deep-frozen 的，两半都**从不就地修改**它：需要
改动时返回新对象，不需要改动时原样返回。

## 文件结构

```text
dsh-teamo-effort/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle / dsh.client / exports['./client']
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 安装时插入的插件行（id: teamo-effort）
├── tsconfig.json         # 源码类型检查（构建用 esbuild）
├── scripts/build.mjs     # Host: ESM；Client: CJS 工厂 + __ModuleLoader__ 包装
├── locale/{zh,en}.json   # 插件页显示用的标题与描述
├── icon.svg
└── src/
    ├── shared.ts         # 两半共用的 TEAMO_EFFORT_NS 与档位定义
    ├── index.ts          # Host 半：Config、agent/request 瀑布、外发注入
    └── client/index.tsx  # Client 半：设置页 + 输入框右侧的折叠强度控件
```

`lib/` 是构建产物，随包提交，安装后无需在 profile 里执行构建。

## 安装

```powershell
# 在 package.json / cordis.patch.yml 所在的包目录执行
dsh plugin --profile desktop add .
```

命令会把本包链接进 profile 并（因为 `dsh.bundle`）把 `teamo-effort` 行加入
`dsh.profile.bundles`。随后**完整重启对应 profile**（DSH 只在进程启动时扫描
`dsh.client`）。

打开 设置 → 侧栏「Teamo 模型强度」→ 选择档位。下一次请求即生效。

卸载：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-teamo-effort
```

## 从源码构建

```powershell
pnpm add -D esbuild typescript
pnpm run build
```

## 与其他插件的边界

- 只使用**类型**导入做跨插件协作，不导入其他插件的运行时值；
- 设置读写走 `configForms`（0.2.x）对应的 Host 配置文档，不写别的插件的配置；
- 输入框控件通过可选的嵌套 `ctx.inject(['slots', 'modelDirectories'])` 读取当前会话的
  模型目录：`modelDirectories` 不存在时只是不显示滑条，设置页照常工作；
- 命名空间常量 `TEAMO_EFFORT_NS = 'teamo-effort'` 由 `src/shared.ts` 提供，
  Host 半与 Client 半共用同一个字面量；profile 可能给 entry id 加 include 前缀，
  Client 半按 `teamo-effort` 或 `:<name>` 后缀识别。

## 已知限制

- 外发注入依赖 `debug` 层的 `fetch` 包装，只有 `body` 为 JSON 字符串的
  `POST` 会被改写；流式上传或 `Request` 对象的请求会原样透传。
- 若 TeamoRouter 后续要求别的字段名（例如某些网关用 `reasoning.effort`），
  改 `src/shared.ts` 的 `TEAMO_EFFORT_FIELD` 重新构建即可。
- 一旦给 Teamo 模型声明了 `reasoningEfforts`，这些模型就进入「有滑块」的一类：
  强度由输入框滑块决定，本插件不再覆盖（设置页和小按钮都会按这条规则退让）。

plugins.description: DSH 任务通知插件：把任务完成、失败和授权请求推送到安卓手机，支持局域网直连和自托管云端中继。
plugins.readme_text:
DSH 任务通知

把 DSH 的任务完成、失败和授权请求推送到安卓手机

中文 | English

> **AI 生成声明**：本项目的大部分代码、文档和测试由 AI 编程助手生成，维护者已进行审查、运行和修正。 DSH 任务通知是一个**自托管**的手机通知方案：DSH 每轮任务结束、执行失败，或弹出工具授权请求时，把结果推送到安卓手机。 它支持两条通道： - **局域网直连**：同一 Wi-Fi 下 UDP 自动发现 + HTTP，无需公网。 - **云端中继**：通过你自己的 HTTPS 服务器转发，手机和电脑不在同一网络也能收到。 不依赖 FCM、ntfy、账号体系或第三方推送服务。 ```mermaid flowchart LR D["DSH Desktop

plugins.description: Floating token & cost monitor for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-token-monitor

[English](README.en.md) · **简体中文**

**整个插件，除了这一行字以外，由DeepSeek Harness生成**

给 DeepSeek Harness 用的悬浮小窗：显示**账户余额**、**当前对话已消耗的 token**，以及按官方价目估算的**本次对话花费**。

贴在窗口右边缘的一个窄竖条 + 展开卡片，可拖动、可收起，不占阅读空间。

```
┌──────────────────────┐ ┌──┐
│ ● 你的对话标题     × │ │¥ │
│ 余额        ¥25.87   │ │25│
│ 本对话     ≈¥0.42 25.4M│ │.8│
└──────────────────────┘ └──┘
        悬停后展开明细 ↑
```

## 功能

- **余额**：读 DeepSeek 账号服务，显示充值钱包（悬停可看赠送余额）
- **本对话消耗**：累加该会话里每次模型调用的 usage
- **本次对话花费**：按 DeepSeek 官方价目估算，分模型、分**高峰/空闲**时段
- **Search / Fetch 计费**：统计 `web_search` / `web_fetch` 调用次数，按官方 5 元/千次计价
  （官方说明 2026-11-01 00:00 前不计费，插件会按日期自动决定是否计入）
- **价格每月自动更新**：从官方价目页抓取，缓存 30 天，抓失败就继续用旧值
- **跟随当前对话**：切换会话立即刷新（识别 DOM 选中态，宿主按标题/id 反查）
- **跟随应用语言**：简体中文 / English，应用里切语言即时同步
- **可拖动**：竖条上下拖，浮窗与竖条始终垂直对齐；位置按视口比例记忆
- **不打扰**：悬停 320ms 才展开明细；鼠标停在 × 那一排时不展开，避免点不中

## 安装

插件是标准的 DSH bundle，同时带 host 半（`index.js`）和 client 半（`client.js`）。

> 命令里的 `<profile>` 换成你要装的 profile 名；桌面版就是 `desktop`。
> `dsh plugin` 会把参数原样转给 pnpm，所以任何 pnpm 能装的 spec 都行。

### 方式 A：从 GitHub 直装（推荐，当前唯一可直接用的一键方式）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Ta9y/dsh-token-monitor
```

### 方式 B：图形界面

**设置 → 插件 → 安装**，粘贴 `github:Ta9y/dsh-token-monitor`。

### 方式 C：手动（适合本地开发调试）

```powershell
cd $HOME\.dsh\profiles\desktop
pnpm add file:C:/path/to/dsh-token-monitor
```

然后把 `dsh-token-monitor` 加进该目录 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组。

### 方式 D：从 npm

> ⚠️ **尚未发布到 npm**，这条命令现在会 404。等发布后可用：
>
> ```bash
> dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-token-monitor
> ```

> 安装后**需要重启一次 DSH 进程**：host 半的代码走 ESM 缓存，重载插件不会重新执行。
> 之后改 `ui.js` / `config.json` 只要刷新页面即可。

## 配置

`config.json`（插件目录下，改完刷新页面生效，不用重启）：

```json
{
  "pollSeconds": 10,        // 页面轮询间隔（秒）
  "balanceSeconds": 60,     // 余额查询间隔（秒）
  "autoPrices": true,       // true = 每月从官网抓价；false = 只用手写的 prices
  "searchPer1000": 5,       // Search 单价（元/千次）
  "fetchPer1000": 5,        // Fetch 单价（元/千次）
  "searchBillingFrom": "2026-11-01",
  "prices": {               // 元 / 百万 token，按模型 + 时段
    "deepseek-flash": {
      "offpeak": { "cacheHit": 0.02, "cacheMiss": 1, "output": 4 },
      "peak":    { "cacheHit": 0.04, "cacheMiss": 2, "output": 8 }
    },
    "deepseek-v4-pro": {
      "offpeak": { "cacheHit": 0.15, "cacheMiss": 4.5, "output": 13.5 },
      "peak":    { "cacheHit": 0.3,  "cacheMiss": 9,   "output": 27 }
    }
  }
}
```

## 花费是怎么算的

单位：元 / 百万 token。高峰 = 北京时间**工作日** 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，其余时段（含周末）为半价。

- 模型从会话的 `requestContext()` 读出；未知模型回落到 `deepseek-flash`
- **按调用发生的时段计价**：每次 usage 按事件时间分进「高峰桶 / 空闲桶」，各用自己的单价
- Search / Fetch 按次计费，和 token 是两笔账
- 法定节假日未处理，所以结果是**估算**，不是账单金额

价格来源：[DeepSeek 官方价目页](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/)，
由插件每月自动抓取并缓存在 `prices.auto.json`（含 `fetchedAt`）；解析失败时保留旧值。

## 隐私

- **不读取**登录令牌、不碰 API Key
- 余额只通过 DSH 自己的账号服务（`ctx.deepseekAccount.getBalance()`）读取
- **不向任何第三方发请求**；唯一的出站请求是每月一次抓官方价目页
- 数据只在本机内存 + 浏览器 `localStorage`（竖条位置）里
- 本地写入的文件：`debug.log`（诊断，可删）、`token.txt`（页面随机令牌）、`prices.auto.json`（价格缓存）

## 兼容性

- 需要 DSH 0.2.x（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `dsh-web-app` 组合）
- 桌面端通过 `dsh.client` 客户端模块注入；纯浏览器模式（`dsh web`）通过 index 注入
- 只在 Windows 的 desktop profile 上实测过

## 已知限制

- 只统计**主会话**，不含子任务（subagent）的花费
- 会话必须是 Host 内存里的 live session 才能统计；冷会话显示 `—`
- 法定节假日的高峰/空闲判断不准（会影响估算）

## 开发

```
index.js            host 半：读余额、累加 usage、HTTP 路由、价格抓取
client.js           client module：把 ui.js 挂进页面，并桥接应用语言
ui.js               悬浮窗本体：纯 DOM + Shadow DOM，无构建、无依赖
cordis.patch.yml    bundle 层：插入插件行
config.json         默认配置
test/smoke.mjs      假 ctx 的回归测试（npm test）
test/prices.mjs     拿真实官方页面验证价格解析（npm run test:prices）
```

### 两个容易踩的坑

1. **bundle patch 插入新行必须用 `insert:`**。`- id: xxx` 是「覆盖已存在条目」的语义，
   条目不存在时只打印 `patch: entry "xxx" not found` 然后**静默跳过** —— 插件看起来装好了但根本没加载。

   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: dsh-token-monitor
         name: 'dsh-token-monitor'
   ```

2. **路由/注入注册必须包在 `ctx.effect()` 里**。否则插件热重载时旧路由不会释放，
   新实例注册同名路径直接抛 duplicate route，`apply` 半路夭折（表现为"改了代码没反应"）。

## 发布到 GitHub

```bash
cd dsh-token-monitor
git init
git add .
git commit -m "feat: dsh-token-monitor 1.0.0"
git branch -M main
git remote add origin https://github.com/Ta9y/dsh-token-monitor.git
git push -u origin main
```

如果想换仓库地址，改 `package.json` 里的 `repository` / `homepage` / `bugs` 三处即可。

仓库建好后记得加 **Topics**（右侧 About 旁的齿轮）：

```
dsh-plugin  dsh  deepseek-harness  deepseek  plugin  token  cost  balance
```

`dsh-plugin` 是检索 DSH 插件时最主要的标签。

# DSH Team Workbench · 超级工作台

[English](README.en.md) · [使用指南](docs/USAGE.md) · [配置](docs/CONFIGURATION.md) · [架构](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)

DeepSeek Harness 的非官方插件：在一个主窗口中以 **1／2／4 窗**查看真实会话，并用持续存在的模块成员组织并行工作。

团队组织方式是 **leader → 模块成员 → 成员自己的子智能体**。leader 给目标和边界，成员自己规划、拆解与授权派发；Host 调度器在依赖满足、容量释放后继续启动已授权工作。

本仓库独立提供工作台与团队运行时，**不包含、也不要求安装 myworkflow 技能包**。

## 能做什么

- **多会话工作台**：切换 1／2／4 窗，保留各会话的草稿与阅读位置，使用 DSH 原生对话组件。
- **模块成员自治**：持久模块委托、成员计划、版本化派发授权、成员收件箱与成果验收。
- **持续补位**：已授权的独立工作按依赖和容量推进，不等待整批结束；保留恢复和交互余量。
- **可追溯交付**：区分产出与验收，关联执行记录、产物哈希、验收条件和未完成事项。
- **运行状态**：查看成员决策、等待原因、任务、用量、费用估算及错误记录。未配置价格或缺少数据时显示未知。

窗格直接绑定工作区主会话；成员和子智能体通过该会话的“子会话”菜单进入。窗口数与并发执行数相互独立。写范围协调也不等于文件系统隔离。

## 兼容范围

已调查的接口基线是 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**。前端依赖该版本的 Session、slot、原生对话组件与布局接口；后续版本需重新核对。

团队执行要求当前 profile 已启用 DSH 原生实验性 Agent Team，并提供可用的 continuable 子智能体 provider。缺失能力时插件会给出诊断，不能把“插件加载成功”视为团队可运行。

此发布提供生产模块的自动化测试、模拟原生接口的集成检查、打包检查及 CI 配置。**它们不构成所有 DSH 版本、操作系统或真实模型的运行认证**。真实安装、多窗和团队行为按[验收说明](docs/ACCEPTANCE.md)另行核实。

## 安装

在装有 DSH CLI 的环境中：

```sh
dsh plugin add github:CH3SH-LC/dsh-team-workbench#v1.0.0
```

如需指定已有 profile，例如 `desktop`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:CH3SH-LC/dsh-team-workbench#v1.0.0
```

请确认安装目标与实际启动的 DSH profile 相同。安装方式遵循 [DSH 官方 bundle 文档](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/develop/basic/publish)。

也可安装本地源码目录或已打包的 `.tgz`。在 DSH 创造模式中，使用原生插件管理工具：

```text
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="github:CH3SH-LC/dsh-team-workbench#v1.0.0")
```

本地安装时将 `target` 替换为本机源码目录的绝对路径。工具行为以[官方 plugin-manager 说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/boot/plugin-manager/README.md)及当前 DSH 版本为准。

**配置影响**：本 bundle 将原生 `subagent` 行设为 `maxDepth: 2`、`maxActiveSubagents: 40`。这会影响同一 profile 中使用该服务的其他任务，不只是工作台。安装前核对已有覆盖配置；详见 [配置说明](docs/CONFIGURATION.md)。没有模型配额或速率限制随安装自动增加。

安装后查看插件加载结果，在侧栏打开“超级工作台”。若当前版本要求重载或重启，应先保存并妥善结束活跃任务，再按 DSH 提示操作。

## 开始使用

可在一个新的 DSH 会话中提出完整目标，例如：

> 创建一个小型游戏内容包。建立敌人内容与装备内容两个模块成员，每个成员交付四个完整对象。成员自行决定对象设计、计划和子任务，独立交付设计说明、结构化数据及验证结果。按完整对象并行，不拆成调研、开发、检查接力。先限制并发，确认流程正常后再调整。

模型侧的推荐路径：

1. leader 用 `team_define`、`team_member_create` 建立团队，再用 `team_mission_assign` 委托模块目标。
2. member 用 `team_plan_submit` 决定自行执行或委派，提交自己的计划，再用 `team_dispatch_authorize` 授权需要派发的工作。
3. Host 调度器启动可执行项；成员通过收件箱和回执继续处理自己的模块。
4. 产物提交后，由 owner 核验。需要可执行验证时使用 `team_exec_check` 记录结果，再由 `team_work_verify` 对照验收条件作出结论。

简单请求可以直接完成，不必创建团队。完整说明见 [使用指南](docs/USAGE.md)。

## 开发与贡献

开发需要 Node.js **22 或更新版本**。源码目录中运行：

```sh
npm run build
npm test
npm run check:package
```

修改前阅读 [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)。测试在完整源码 checkout 中运行；发布的 `.tgz` 是运行时包。前端生成文件应由构建脚本生成；不要只修改 `client.js`。公开问题报告请去除私有路径、会话正文、账号标识和凭据。

## 文档

- [使用指南与工具分工](docs/USAGE.md)
- [配置、容量和数据位置](docs/CONFIGURATION.md)
- [架构与运行约束](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [真实 DSH 验收清单](docs/ACCEPTANCE.md)
- [发布流程](docs/RELEASE.md)
- [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md)

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)。本项目由社区独立维护，与 DeepSeek 官方没有隶属或背书关系。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-dock（提示词修改助手）

[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-2f6fed)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.x-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness)
[![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.1.0-2f6fed)](https://github.com/wnei-f/dsh-prompt-dock/releases)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)

DSH 插件，挂在**输入框工具行**（`conversation.input.right`，模型选择左侧），对输入框草稿做两件事：

- **AI 改写**：更简洁 / 更详细 / 结构化 / 译成英文 / 自定义；SSE 流式输出、可取消、写入后可撤销
- **模板插入**：常用提示词模板一键追加到草稿

> 改写结果为 AI 辅助生成，请自行核实内容。

工具行从左到右是「风格 / 模板 / 改写」三个独立控件：风格与模板各自是一级触发器、互不嵌套；「改写」是本插件这一行最靠右的控件，紧邻官方模型选择器。**设置已从工具行移入 DSH 官方「插件」页**。下拉箭头、选中态、开关沿用官方主题令牌，选中项用底色 + 细阴影描边而不是打勾。「改写」为纯图标（官方 sparkle 形状，文案在 tooltip），进行中显示转圈 + 已接收字符数，完成后同一槽位变成「↩ 撤销」。

模型默认走 DSH 全局默认模型（`agentDefaultModel`），也可在插件配置里固定为某个模型；改写在宿主半调用 `ctx.llm.stream`。

---

## 目录

- [界面交互](#界面交互)
- [设置](#设置)
- [提示词设计](#提示词设计)
- [隐私与版权](#隐私与版权)
- [安全与边界](#安全与边界)
- [兼容性](#兼容性)
- [路由与错误码](#路由与错误码)
- [安装](#安装)
- [开发](#开发)

---

## 界面交互

### 工具行三级降级

按可用宽度自动切换布局，避免在窄容器里挤压官方控件：

| 层级 | 条件 | 布局 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| L0 完整 | 宽度 > `compactThreshold`（默认 320px） | 风格 / 模板 / 改写三个独立控件 |
| L1 紧凑 | 宽度 ≤ 阈值 | 风格与模板只显示图标 + tooltip |
| L2 合并 | 宽度 < 阈值 × 0.75 | 回退为单一两级菜单 |

若配置里把 `showStyleEntry` 或 `showTemplateEntry` 设为 `never`，直接进入 L2。

### 快捷键

默认 `Alt+M` 打开风格、`Alt+T` 打开模板、`Alt+R` 改写，可在插件配置的「快捷键」分组修改。

**输入框里也能用**：带 `Alt` / `Ctrl` / `Cmd` 的组合键即使焦点在输入框中也会触发；单独按字符键仍交还给输入框，不会吞掉正在打的字。

**修改方式**：点击设置里的快捷键输入框 → 直接按下想要的组合键，自动录入为规范格式（如 `Alt+J`），不需要手打字符串。

| 操作 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `Esc` | 放弃本次录入 |
| `Backspace` / `Delete` | 清空该绑定 |
| 只按修饰键 | 继续等待，不提交 |
| 未包含修饰键 | 拒绝提交并提示 |

### 浮层键盘导航

浮层打开时焦点仍在输入框，因此插件在 `document` 捕获阶段接管方向键：

| 按键 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `↑` / `↓` | 逐项切换高亮（实时跟随，首尾不越界，连按不丢步） |
| `Home` / `End` | 跳到第一项 / 最后一项 |
| `Enter` | 选中当前项，**不会发送输入框内容** |
| `Esc` | 关闭浮层并把焦点交还触发器 |

当前键盘项用品牌色内描边标出（`.pd-optionActive`），与「已选中的风格」（底色 + 细描边）是两个不同的视觉状态，可以同时出现。中文输入法组合中（`isComposing`）不拦截回车，避免与候选词确认冲突。

### 风格 / 模板互相切换

两个浮层共用一套快捷键，可以互相直接切换，不需要先关闭：

| 当前状态 | 按下 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 浮层关闭 | `Alt+M` / `Alt+T` | 打开对应浮层 |
| 风格开着 | `Alt+T` | 直接切到模板 |
| 模板开着 | `Alt+M` | 直接切到风格 |
| 风格开着 | `Alt+M` | 关闭（原有 toggle 语义） |
| 模板开着 | `Alt+T` | 关闭（原有 toggle 语义） |
| 浮层开着 | `Alt+R` | 拦下，避免误触发改写 |

### 反馈

改写走一个六态状态机，所有提示由同一套组件渲染：

| 状态 | 表现 |
| --- | --- |
| idle | sparkle 图标 + 主按钮填充 |
| requesting | 转圈，按钮禁用，tooltip「正在连接…」 |
| streaming | 转圈 + 「改写中 N 字」，输入框上缘 2px 流光条 |
| success | 同槽位变成「↩ 撤销」，1.5s 绿色高亮，toast「改写完成，可撤销」 |
| error | 恢复 sparkle，1px 危险色描边，左侧错误条 + 重试 |
| cancelled | 回到 idle |

**六类错误**各有固定文案，**不展示原始错误文本**：网络失败、超时、认证/配置、模型返回错误、空结果、用户取消。错误日志只记录类型与耗时，原始信息写入浏览器控制台。

**提示显示位置**：错误提示、长度提示、芯片说明统一显示在**工具行左侧**（绝对定位的旁注槽位），出现和消失都不会挪动「风格 / 模板 / 改写」三个按钮。同一时刻只显示一条，优先级：错误 > 长度提示 > 芯片说明。窄视口（< 640px）左侧放不下时自动改挂到工具行下方，仍不影响按钮位置。

**Toast** 位于底部居中，最多 2 条，2.8s 自动消失，尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`。

### 设置卡片

- **风格库 / 模板库默认折叠**：每条只显示「名称 + 摘要」，点击标题栏才展开编辑，避免一屏塞满输入框。
- **上下文开关**旁显示「已开启 / 已关闭」文字，下方说明随状态变化，不只依赖滑块颜色。
- **加载态**：配置尚未读到时显示「正在读取配置…」；读取失败则显示原因 + 重试，不会渲染成空白卡片。
- **首次使用告知**：首次点击「改写」时提示「点击改写会将当前草稿发送至你配置的模型」，关闭后不再出现。

---

## 设置

设置不是插件自己的 JSON 文件，而是 DSH 官方的插件配置：

- **入口**：侧栏 **插件** → 找到 `dsh-prompt-dock` → 打开它的页面，配置区在页面里（`plugins.bundle.config` 插槽，以**包名** `dsh-prompt-dock` 为 key）。
- **存储**：写入当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，由 DSH 的 `configEditor` 管理，插件本身不直接读写该文件。
- **生效**：每个字段都是 Config 的 `.volatile()` 字段，保存后无需重启，改写行为立即变化。

### 配置分组

| 分组 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 改写模型 | 跟随全局默认，或固定为某个 `provider/model`（同名模型按 provider 区分显示） |
| 上下文 | 是否附带最近对话、附带轮数（1–20） |
| 全局改写纪律 | system prompt 的共同纪律；默认只读，可解锁编辑，也可一键恢复默认 |
| 风格库 | 每个风格的 `name` / `instruction` 可编辑 |
| 模板库 | 每条模板的 `text` / `category` / `tags` 可编辑，可增删 |
| 工具行 | `showStyleEntry` / `showTemplateEntry`（auto / always / never）、`compactThreshold` |
| 快捷键 | 三个快捷键，点击后直接按组合键录入 |

### 配置字段

对应 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `dsh-prompt-dock` 行的 `config`：

```yaml
- id: dsh-prompt-dock
  name: dsh-prompt-dock
  config:
    rewriteProvider: deepseek-official   # 空串 = 跟随全局默认
    rewriteModel: deepseek-chat          # 空串 = 跟随全局默认
    timeoutMs: 90000                     # 5000–300000
    useContext: true
    contextRounds: 6                     # 1–20
    globalDiscipline: ""                 # 空串 = 用内置默认
    styles: { concise: { name: 更简洁, instruction: "……" } }
    templates: { t-review: { name: 代码审查, text: "……", category: 代码, tags: [review] } }
    showStyleEntry: auto                 # auto | always | never
    showTemplateEntry: auto
    compactThreshold: 320                # 160–1200
    shortcutStyle: Alt+M
    shortcutTemplate: Alt+T
    shortcutRewrite: Alt+R
```

字段约束：模板 ≤ 100 条，`name` ≤ 60 字、`text` ≤ 4000 字；风格 `name` ≤ 40 字、`instruction` ≤ 2000 字；共同纪律 ≤ 4000 字。超限在保存时截断。

### 从旧版迁移

旧版把设置放在 `~/.dsh/prompt-dock/settings.json`。升级后首次启动会自动：

1. 读取旧文件，转换成官方配置字段；
2. **只回填官方配置里尚未由用户设置过的字段**（已设过的值不会被旧文件覆盖）；
3. 把旧文件原子改名为 `settings.json.migrated`，此后不再读写（超过 30 天自动清理）。

回填以 `settings.describe()` 返回的 `user` 层区分「用户设过」与「用了默认值」，因此重复启动是幂等的。

---

## 提示词设计

改写分两条**互不相干**的链路：

- **共同纪律 + 风格 instruction** → 改写请求的 `system` prompt（纪律在前，风格在后）
- **模板 text** → 直接插入输入框的正文，**不进 system prompt**

### 共同纪律（system prompt 主体）

内置默认文案的核心是「**改写器不是需求生成器**」：只让草稿更可用，不新增草稿里没有的事实、数据、案例或结论。改写前先做**性质判断**：

- 草稿若是确认、道谢、闲聊、简单提问或纯情绪表达 → 原样返回或只修正明显语病，**不按任何风格扩写**
- 草稿若是可执行的任务请求 → 再按风格约束改写

六条共同约定：

1. 只输出改写后的正文，不输出解释、前言、问候、改写说明
2. 逐字保留：反引号内代码、文件路径、命令行参数、函数/变量/类名、URL、`@引用`、`/命令`、Markdown 结构
3. 逐字保留：专有名词、规范术语、直接引语中的措辞、具体数字与版本号
4. 不把用户的观察改写成结论（「我觉得它有点慢」不得变成「它性能不足」）
5. 不替用户做草稿未做的决定；不确定处保留原表述
6. 控制长度：不低于 80 字；超限先收敛，仍超则保持原样并提示

第 6 条是**软约束**：代码层不自动截断，而是在预览区加琥珀色提示。纪律在设置里默认只读，可解锁编辑，也可一键「恢复默认」（存为空串，后续版本改进默认文案会自动生效）。

### 四个风格 instruction

| 风格 | 实际约束 |
| --- | --- |
| 更简洁 | 删重复、修饰、客套；必须原样保留全部约束与否定条件、失败路径与异常处理要求、数字与阈值、文件/接口/字段名、验收标准；不得把含义不同的两句合并、不得把并列要求压成一个；目标 **50%–70% 且不低于 80 字** |
| 更详细 | 只补草稿已隐含的目标/输入/输出/边界/验证方式；**禁止**引入未提及的技术选型、第三方库、数据结构或数据；判断强度不变；目标 **1.5–2.5 倍且不超过 800 字**，草稿不足三行时按内容补全而不做比例扩写 |
| 结构化 | 固定章节序：目标 / 上下文 / 任务步骤 / 约束 / 输出格式；缺失章节写「未指定」而非编造；步骤以动词开头按序排列；标识符/路径/数字保留原形；只重组不新增需求 |
| 译成英文 | 地道英文技术写作；逐字保留代码、路径、命令行参数、标识符、URL、术语、直接引语、数字与版本号；保留 Markdown 与 `@引用` `/命令`；保持判断强度，不扩写不解释不补充建议；无公认译法时保留原文并括号注明 |

「自定义」风格的 instruction 为空串，改写时读取**该风格自身**的 `instruction`（在设置卡片「风格库」里编辑）；若该指令为空且请求未提供一次性覆盖，报 `NO_INSTRUCTION`。

### 三个模板 text

三个模板统一遵循「**任务 + 禁止项 + 兜底**」结构——先说做什么，再说不能做什么，最后规定信息不足或没有发现时怎么办，避免模型硬凑内容。

| 模板 | 任务 | 禁止项 | 兜底 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 代码审查 | 按严重程度降序，每条给「位置 / 问题类型 / 触发条件 / 最小修复方向」 | 只报能定位的问题；不假设未展示代码有问题；不评价命名与格式偏好 | 无问题则输出「未发现可定位问题」，并列未覆盖部分 |
| 解释代码 | 依次说明：整体职责、数据流、边界与失败路径、对调用方的约束 | 标识符/路径/数字不意译；不评价好坏、不提改进建议 | 无法确认处标「未验证」，不推测 |
| 写测试 | 每个用例给「名称 / 输入 / 预期结果 / 覆盖路径」 | 不修改被测代码、不改签名、不重命名、不引入新测试框架、不 mock 被测逻辑本身 | 无法确定预期行为时列为待确认问题，不编造断言 |

> 以上都是**默认值**。在插件配置里保存过风格或模板后，config 中的值会覆盖内置默认。

---

## 隐私与版权

- **草稿不落日志、不落磁盘**：草稿原文只用于当次改写调用，从不写入日志、探针文件或任何持久化文件。错误日志只记录错误类型、耗时与字符数。开发期探针接口在写盘前会剔除 `draft` / `text` / `content` 等草稿字段，仅保留字符数。
- **不接触凭据**：插件不读取任何 API Key，模型凭据由宿主 `llm` 服务持有；配置里也不保存凭据。
- **无外网出口**：改写不直接发起网络请求，而是走宿主 `llm` 服务；插件自身没有明文 HTTP 出口，也不提供可降级到 http 的配置项。
- **AI 辅助告知**：首次点击「改写」时提示草稿会发送到你配置的模型，关闭后不再出现。
- **许可证**：MIT，覆盖插件代码、内置模板正文与风格指令，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

---

## 安全与边界

- **回环围栏**：所有 `/api/prompt-dock/*` 只接受本机来源（校验 socket 地址、`Host`、`Origin`，并拒绝带 `X-Forwarded-For` / `Forwarded` 的请求）。`*.localhost` 与非 http(s) 的自定义 scheme（桌面壳 `app://`、`tauri://`、`file://`）放行，http(s) 必须是回环。**不要**把 dsh web 暴露在反向代理后还期望这道围栏生效。
- **改写限流**：同一宿主进程内并发改写上限 2，每分钟成功调用上限 10（失败调用不占配额）。
- **芯片保护**：草稿含 `@文件` / `/命令` 引用芯片时，「改写」置灰并提示。判据取自宿主真实发布状态——`InputState.occurrences` 非空即视为含芯片。
- **变更检测**：改写期间若草稿被改动，结果不会回填，避免覆盖新输入。
- **只走 `inputActions.setDraft`**：不猜测其它方法名。宿主不支持时显式报错，而不是静默换一条未知路径。

### 权限清单（与 `package.json` 的 `dsh.permissions` 一致）

| 能力 | 声明值 | 实际用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `network.fetch` / `network.socket` | `false` / `false` | 不发起任何外部网络请求；改写经宿主 `llm` 服务 |
| `process.child_process` | `true` | 仅「打开配置文件」：调用系统文件管理器（`explorer.exe` / `open` / `xdg-open`）定位当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` |
| `filesystem.read` / `fs.write` | `$DSH_HOME/prompt-dock` | 仅旧配置目录：读取一次旧 `settings.json` 做回填、改名为 `.migrated`、清理 30 天前过期文件。官方设置由 DSH 官方 `configEditor` 写入 |
| `env.read` | `DSH_HOME`、`DSH_PROMPT_D

plugins.description: Hide unused models, rename them, keep the billing rate visible — a model list manager for DeepSeek Harness. 隐藏用不到的模型、给模型改备注名、保留厂商计费倍率。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-tidy

**中文** · [English](README.en.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [Русский](README.ru.md)

一个让 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器保持整洁的插件——决定哪些模型出现、给模型和渠道起你认得的名字、按你觉得顺手的顺序排列，并保住厂商标注的计费倍率。

![模型整理设置页](docs/screenshots/main.png)

## 它解决的问题

装两三个 provider 插件，模型菜单就变成一堵墙。一条免费车道、一个工作台 App、两个自己配的网关，转眼三十来项——大多数你根本不会选，还有几个是同一模型走了不同渠道的近似重复项。

模型选择器是**做决定的地方，不是仓库**。它应该只摆你真正在用的那几个，用你认得的名字，按你定义好的顺序。

## 它做什么

安装后，DSH 设置里会出现「**模型整理**」分区。模型按来源渠道分组，每个渠道一张卡片，每一项各带一个开关：

```
┌─ WorkBuddy ──────── 8/12 ─ [渠道备注] [恢复排序] [隐藏本渠道] [显示本渠道] ─┐
│ ▲▼  Auto                                            ●───                  │
│ ▲▼  GLM-5.3 · x0.79                                 ●───                  │
│ ▲▼  GLM-5.2 · x0.79 · 夜间折扣         ● [改备注]   ───●                  │
│ ▲▼  Grok-4.7 · x1.90                                 ───●                  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ our-free-model ── 6/6 ─ [渠道备注] [恢复排序] [隐藏本渠道] [显示本渠道] ─┐
│ ▲▼  Kilo Auto Free                                  ●───                  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- **每个模型一个开关**：关掉即从模型选择器消失，打开即回来。
- **上/下箭头**：渠道卡片与其内部模型都能用箭头调整先后顺序（图标 `▲▼`）。
- **模型备注名**：给模型起个你认得的名字，选择器就以它显示；厂商的计费后缀会原样留在末尾。
- **渠道备注名**：给渠道本身起个名字，选择器里的分组标题就换成它，渠道 id 以小字保留在旁边。
- **搜索**：按模型名、渠道、备注名过滤。
- **渠道级批量**：一键隐藏或显示某个渠道的全部模型。
- **全局显示 / 隐藏**：两个按钮作用于整个目录。
- **返回顶部**：列表很长时，右下角有一个按钮直接回到顶部。
- **恢复**：一个按钮清空全部备注，另一个让全部模型回来。

## 自定义排序（模型）

每个模型左侧有一对箭头，用来调整它在所属渠道内的先后顺序。排序是**显式保存**的：调完重启 DSH、换一台机器同步配置，顺序都还在。

- **只影响排列，不影响可见性**：排过序的模型被隐藏后，它的位置记在保存的顺序里；重新显示时回到原来的位置。
- **新模型排在你排过的那些之后**：渠道以后上架新模型，不会插进你精心安排的那一段中间。
- **搜索时可以继续排序**：筛选状态下点箭头，交换的是**当前可见的相邻两项**，所以点一下就能看到变化；被筛掉的模型保持它自己的相对位置。
- **一键回退**：渠道头的「恢复排序」清掉该渠道的自定义顺序，回到目录原本的排列。

## 自定义排序（渠道）

每个渠道卡片头部也有一对箭头，可以把常用的渠道调到最上面。渠道顺序**独立存储**（`providerOrder`），与会话无关，重启后仍然生效。

- **只重排你动过的**：你从未移动过的渠道、以及之后新注册的渠道，都保持它们原有的位置、排在最后。
- **与内部排序互不干扰**：移动渠道不影响每个渠道内部的模型顺序。
- **一键回退**：控制区顶部的「恢复渠道默认顺序」回到 harness 自带的渠道排列。

## 给渠道改名

渠道也可以备注。点卡片头的「渠道备注」，输入你认得的名字，模型选择器里的分组标题就会换成它——比如把 `our-free-model` 叫成「白嫖车道」。

- **只改标题**：路由按渠道 id 走，改名不影响任何请求；正在进行的会话照常继续。
- **id 仍然可见**：改名后原渠道 id 以小字留在标题旁边，方便对照配置。
- **留空即恢复**：把备注清空，标题就回到渠道自己发布的名字。
- **与模型备注互不干扰**：两张表分开存储，改渠道名不会动模型名，反之亦然。

## 返回顶部

模型列表可以很长。右下角固定一个圆形按钮，点一下就把当前可见区域平滑滚回顶部——不用再手动向上拖。

它会自动找到真正的滚动容器（设置页的外层滚动区，而不是整个页面），所以滚动目标永远是对的。

## 改备注不会弄丢倍率

厂商把计费倍率拼在模型的**显示名**里——`GLM-5.3 · x0.79`——因为 harness 的模型目录没有倍率字段。直接替换这个名字（大多数改名的做法）会把倍率一并丢掉。

本插件按厂商自己的分隔符切开名字，并保留后半段：

| | 选择器里显示的名字 |
|---|---|
| 厂商原名 | `GLM-5.3 · x0.79` |
| 改备注为「GLM 便宜」 | **`GLM 便宜 · x0.79`** |
| 带促销标签时改备注 | **`GLM 便宜 · x0.79 · 夜间折扣`** |
| 本身没有倍率的模型 | `自动` ← 不会多出分隔符 |

## 隐藏一个模型不会让它跑位

被隐藏的模型不在目录里（harness 会把它过滤掉），所以它的行只能靠保存下来的信息重建。**顺理成章地把行追加到末尾，会让它一被隐藏就跳到分组底部**。本插件记住每一行首次出现的位置，所以隐藏五个里的第三个，它仍然排在第三。

## 它刻意不做的事

**整理是显示层的决定，绝不是配置改动。**

- 不重写你的渠道配置。隐藏列表、模型备注、渠道备注与排序记录都只存在本插件自己的设置命名空间里。
- 正在使用某模型的会话不受影响——路由按模型 id 走，改的只是显示名。
- 卸载插件后列表完全恢复原样。
- 渠道新上架的模型默认可见。本插件记录的是「要隐藏什么、要改什么名、要排什么序」，从不是「要显示什么」。
- **不做可用性检测**：各渠道有自己的排查方式，一个列表整理插件不该消耗你的 token 去试探模型。

## 覆盖范围

开关作用于**所有**模型来源，不限于手工配置的渠道。插件过滤的是 harness 自己的目录枚举——`ctx.llm.listModels` 与 `ctx.llm.listProviders`，也就是每个界面都会读的那一份列表。其他插件通过 `ctx.llm.registerAdapter` 注册的模型、以及 `llm-pi-ai` 下声明的渠道，都落在这一份列表里，因此都被覆盖。

行按 **渠道 + 模型** 作键，所以同一模型名经两条路由进来仍是两行独立控制：`workbuddy/gemini-3.8-flash` 与 `gemini/gemini-3.8-flash` 是不同的上游服务，各有各的开关和备注。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-model-tidy
```

然后重新打开 DSH Web GUI，设置导航里会出现「**模型整理**」。

## 开发

无需构建：两半都以 harness 直接加载的原始文件形式发布。宿主半是 ES 模块；浏览器半是 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 工厂——客户端模块系统调用的格式。

```sh
npm test
```

一次跑完十二套测试：目录过滤器、倍率后缀切分、浏览器半行为、备注后缀抓取、行序保持、模型自定义排序、渠道自定义排序、渠道改名、排序渲染、返回顶部、渲染结构，以及与另一个包装同一个方法的插件共存。

`npm run check:packaging` 校验客户端依赖声明指向的包在 harness 中真实存在。

## 兼容性

针对 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 开发。要求 DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.1`——该版本起设置层才提供本插件分区写入所用的 `configForms` 服务。宿主兼容声明以 `package.json` 的 `dsh.compatibility.dsh` 为准（当前 `>=0.2.0-rc.1`），并已在 DSH `0.2.1` 实机完成安装、启动、功能与卸载还原验证。

Node 支持范围声明为 `>=20`（`engines.node`）；开发与 CI 均在 Node 24 上运行，全部测试通过。

## 联系

有想改进的功能、或遇到使用问题，欢迎到 [Issues](https://github.com/star-Cosmo/dsh-model-tidy/issues) 提；也可以直接发邮件给作者：chenbin2004sz@163.com。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: Codex-style Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: UI Automation + screenshots + SendInput, liquid-glass screen overlay, ESC kill switch. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:esch30636/dsh-computer-use
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-computer-use

[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/esch30636/dsh-computer-use?sort=semver)](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-4B5563)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Codex-style **Windows computer use** for DeepSeek Harness: window-targeted UI Automation + occlusion-tolerant screenshots + SendInput mouse/keyboard injection, exposed as five model-facing tools and backed by a bundled long-lived PowerShell helper.

While computer use is active, a click-through **screen overlay** draws a vivid "liquid glass" look: a sapphire *edge vignette* (fully clear center, satin-navy darkening toward the four screen edges) with a thin cyan glass rim hugging the display border, plus a "dynamic island" status pill at the top center — sapphire gradient, diagonal sheen, bright rim, breathing blue glow: `DeepSeek Harness 正在操控你的电脑 | 按 ESC 终止`. Pressing **ESC** stops computer use immediately and closes the overlay; the agent is told to stop and reports back.

Designed after the OpenAI Codex Windows Computer Use surface (`list_apps` / `get_window_state` / `click(element_index | x,y)` / `press_key` / `type_text` / `scroll` / `drag` / `set_value` / `activate_window`, X11-keysym-style key names, one action then re-observe), reimplemented as a pure DSH plugin with no third-party runtime dependencies.

## What you get

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `computer_list_windows` | List targetable top-level windows (window_id, process identity, title, rect, foreground/minimized, policy-blocked flag). Optionally lists Start-menu launchable apps. |
| `computer_observe` | Capture one window state: screenshot (default) and/or UI Automation tree with element indexes, focused element, selection, document text. Returns `state_id` + screenshot coordinate mapping. |
| `computer_action` | Exactly one action against a state: click / double_click / right_click / middle_click / mouse_move / type / key / scroll / drag / set_value / wait / activate_window. |
| `computer_launch_app` | Launch by exe path, exe name, Start-menu display name, `.lnk`, or `shell:AppsFolder\<AUMID>`; reports the windows it opened. |
| `computer_sequence` | Run up to 100 ordered input steps on one window without re-observing between them (absolute screen pixels) — for repetitive GUI work such as drawing a diagram; optionally returns one verification screenshot. |

Plus the click-through status overlay with the **ESC kill switch** (`USER_ESCAPE`), a system-prompt section (workflow, hard denies, confirmation policy) and a `computer-use` skill with the full playbook.

## Requirements

- Windows 10/11, interactive user session (not a service session), PowerShell 5.1 (`powershell.exe` — pwsh 7 not required).
- DSH 0.2.x (web/desktop profile; any composition that mounts `tools`, `systemPrompt` and `attachments` — the shipped base mounts all three).
- No native modules, no npm dependencies, no MCP server.

## Install

### Option A — DSH CLI (`dsh plugin add`)

For profiles the `dsh` CLI can manage (`web`, `tui`, `headless`, …), the plugin
installs as a regular DSH bundle:

```sh
# straight from GitHub (pnpm fetches the repo tarball)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:esch30636/dsh-computer-use

# or from the release tarball (no git fetch; works behind a GitHub proxy too)
dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases/latest/download/dsh-computer-use.tgz"
```

`dsh plugin` installs the package into the profile and enables its bundle.
Restart the host (or let HMR recompose) and the `computer_*` tools appear in a
new session.

### Option B — Desktop app (`desktop` profile)

The Desktop app owns its reserved `desktop` profile, so `dsh plugin --profile
desktop` deliberately refuses to run there. Two supported paths:

1. **Plugin market** — after this plugin is listed in
   [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) (submission pending the
   one-day repository age rule), open **设置 → 插件市场** and install it with one
   click.
2. **Release installer** (works immediately, no git/pnpm needed): download and
   unzip the archive from
   [releases](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases), then run
   inside the unzipped folder:

   ```powershell
   # downloads the latest release tarball and installs into the desktop profile
   powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install-release.ps1
   ```

   Pin a version with `-Version v1.1.0`; target another profile with
   `-Profile web`; add `-Verify` to run the offline composition dump afterwards.

### Option C — manual / fully offline

Download the release archive
([releases](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases)), unzip it,
then run the bundled installer:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1 -Profile desktop
```

The installer copies the package to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-computer-use`, appends `dsh-computer-use` to `dsh.profile.bundles` (backing up `package.json`), and installs the skill to `%USERPROFILE%\.agents\skills\computer-use`. It works for any profile, e.g. `-Profile cu-test`, and `-Verify` dumps the composed profile offline.

Uninstall:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1 -Profile desktop -Uninstall
```

> **Note on the package name:** an unrelated npm package already uses the name
> `dsh-computer-use`, so `dsh plugin add dsh-computer-use` would install that one.
> Install this plugin through the GitHub spec or the release tarball URL shown
> above. Windows-only (`os: win32`): the helper drives a real interactive desktop
> session via UI Automation + SendInput.

## Configure

Options go in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (the row id is `computer-use`):

```yaml
- id: computer-use
  config:
    # extra process names/paths to deny (built-in denies always stay unless an
    # allow-* escape hatch is enabled)
    blockedProcesses: [msedge.exe]
    # allowlist mode: only these processes may be automated
    # allowedProcesses: [notepad.exe, mspaint.exe]
    screenshotMaxWidth: 1600
    screenshotMaxHeight: 1200
    maxElements: 600
    maxTreeDepth: 12
    idleTimeoutMs: 600000
    startupTimeoutMs: 90000
    requestTimeoutMs: 30000
    confirmRiskyActions: true
    warnWhenApprovalUnavailable: true
    allowWindowsKey: false
    allowTerminalAutomation: false
    keepScreenshots: false
    # screen overlay + ESC kill switch
    overlayEnabled: true
    overlayMessage: "DeepSeek Harness 正在操控你的电脑　|　按 ESC 终止"
    overlayIdleTimeoutMs: 90000
    overlayEdgeOpacity: 55
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `helperPath` | bundled | Override the helper script path. |
| `powershellPath` | `powershell.exe` | PowerShell used to host the helper. |
| `idleTimeoutMs` | `600000` | Kill the idle helper; it restarts on the next call. |
| `startupTimeoutMs` | `90000` | First-call budget (PowerShell start + Add-Type compile). |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-request budget once warm (screenshots/UIA use longer internal budgets). |
| `screenshotMaxWidth` / `screenshotMaxHeight` | `1600` / `1200` | Helper-side downscale bounds before the attachment store. |
| `maxElements` / `maxTreeDepth` / `maxTextChars` | `600` / `12` / `20000` | Accessibility tree bounds. |
| `blockedProcesses` / `blockedWindowClasses` | `[]` | Extra denials added to the built-in list. |
| `allowedProcesses` | `[]` | When non-empty: allowlist mode (everything else is denied). |

plugins.description: A multi-agent group chat for DSH that decides who is worth waking: durable message log, attention routing, and cross-workspace membership.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-attention-group

**A multi-agent group chat for DSH that decides who is worth waking.**

[English](README.md) · [中文](README.zh.md)

A durable room for several DSH sessions — plus your own — where a message is written down
first, routed second, and only then allowed to wake anyone. An irrelevant message costs
**zero turns**.

---

## Why this is not another group chat

Every group chat spends its budget at delivery time: it wakes everyone, and each woken
member then discovers the message was not for them. That is N turns for one message nobody
needed.

This plugin moves the decision *before* the wake. Posting a message returns a routing plan

```
routing: SILENT — nobody matched, zero turns spent
```

or

```
routing: 1 recipient(s) — plan only, nothing woken
  room-admin	mention	not-woken (dry run)
```

Waking is a second, explicit step, and it needs **two** switches to agree (see
[Two switches](#waking-is-two-switches)).

Three consequences that are design rules here, not accidents:

- **Creating a room, adding members, reading history, exporting and summarising never wake anybody.**
- **A panel message that names nobody wakes nobody** — only NAMING somebody (`@name`, or `@所有人`
  while the room has 「允许 @所有人」 on) **and** the room's 「唤醒」 switch being on makes the panel
  wake those people. Beyond that, the only panel action that starts a turn is 「生成群史摘要」 (also
  gated on 「唤醒」 — see [Room-history summaries](#room-history-summaries-r9)). No name, no event:
  a person typing in their own panel is not a reason to run somebody else's session.
- **Nothing calls another plugin.** Rooms, transcripts, conclusions and exports are plain
  files, so this works on a bare DSH and survives this plugin being uninstalled.

---

## Quick start

### What you need

- DSH **0.2.1-rc.2** (this is the version every interface here was last verified against; it was
  first built against 0.2.0-rc.2, re-verified on 0.2.1-rc.1, and re-checked on 0.2.1-rc.2).
- A profile to install into. The examples below use `--profile desktop`.

### Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:cilarx/dsh-attention-group
```

That is the whole install. It was **verified end to end from a clean profile** on 2026-10-17:
the command exits 0, DSH initializes the profile, and the package lands with all seven
source files, its bundle patch and its `cordis.patch.yml`.

The bare-name form `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-attention-group` does **not** resolve
yet, because there is no npm release. Use the `github:` form above, or the
[latest release tarball](https://github.com/cilarx/dsh-attention-group/releases/latest):

```bash
# download dsh-attention-group-0.1.4.tgz from the release page, then:
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "C:\path\to\dsh-attention-group-0.1.4.tgz"
```

Any of a directory path, a tarball, or a git URL works, because `dsh plugin` **is** package
management: it delegates to `pnpm` in the profile directory (run `dsh plugin --profile <name>`
with no subcommand and pnpm's own help comes back). What makes the package a *plugin* is that
`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`.

A fresh profile gets **both halves** of the contract written for it automatically — the
dependency *and* the bundle layer — which is what makes the plugin actually load rather than
merely be installed:

```json
{ "dependencies": { "dsh-attention-group": "github:cilarx/dsh-attention-group" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "dsh-attention-group"] } } }
```

### Offline / from a checkout

Installing by path works too, and a packed tarball is verified end to end:

```bash
npm pack --pack-destination /tmp
dsh plugin --profile some-fresh-name add /tmp/dsh-attention-group-0.1.4.tgz
# → dsh: initialized profile some-fresh-name at ~/.dsh/profiles/some-fresh-name
```

Afterwards the new profile's `package.json` contained **both** halves of the contract on its
own — the dependency *and* the bundle layer:

```json
{ "dependencies": { "dsh-attention-group": "file:...tgz" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "dsh-attention-group"] } } }
```

and importing the installed copy from inside that profile succeeded, resolving
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` from the shared `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules`. So **a brand-new
profile can load this plugin** — that is what "works on a bare DSH" means here.

**A `link:` dependency and a directory junction both fail** (`unverified` for your machine,
measured here on 2026-10-16). Node resolves imports from a module's *real* path, so a linked
copy outside the profile resolves `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` outside the profile too:

```
attention-group (dsh-attention-group): failed to import
ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'
```

Installing a real copy inside the profile is what fixes it.

### Verify the install registered

Two places in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` must name the package — a package
that is only in `dependencies` is installed but **is not a profile layer**, and nothing will
happen:

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-attention-group": "..." },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "...", "dsh-attention-group" ] } }
}
```

### Restart DSH — this step is not optional

Host-side code (`src/index.js` and friends) is loaded once, at startup. Toggling the plugin
in the plugin panel does **not** re-import it; measured here, a newly added tool stayed
`unknown tool` across a toggle and appeared only after a restart. Install, then restart, then
look for the 「群聊」 entry in the sidebar.

### Development loop (source tree → live profile)

Because of the real-path rule above, editing this checkout edits nothing that DSH loads.
`tools/sync-plugin.ps1` copies the package into the profile and then *imports the copy* to
prove it still loads:

```powershell
pwsh -File tools/sync-plugin.ps1
```

### First 60 seconds

1. Sidebar → 「群聊」 → 「＋」 → name the room.
2. Settings → turn 「唤醒」 on only when you actually want group messages to be able to start
   turns.
3. Settings → add a member: **click the id box** and a list of this machine's sessions appears
   (title, workspace, last activity, most recent first) — click one and both the id and the
   `@` name are filled in. Pasting an id (`session-<uuid>` **or** a bare `<uuid>`) still works,
   and any stable id with kind `user` / `admin` / `bot` / `liaison` makes it a name in the room.
4. Ask the agent in that session to call `attention_group_list`, then `attention_send` with
   `wake` left off — you get the plan, and nobody is disturbed.

### Confirm the runtime is healthy

Call the `attention_probe` tool. It reports the data root, how many rooms exist, which live
agents are visible, which optional services this deployment offers, the last five wake-up
attempts with the path each one took, the status of the panel route (`registered`, or the
exact reason it is not), and whether the unread prompt line registered (`promptContext` — a
deployment with no prompt service loses that nudge, and this says so). A missing panel that
reads as "you have no rooms" is the failure this line exists to prevent.

---

## Core concepts

### Room

A room is a record in a JSON ledger plus one append-only JSONL transcript. It has an id
derived from its title (`插件工程协调-fpab`), a title, a charter, a member list, a routing
mode, one group-wide reasoning-effort knob, four sink settings, and a list of outgoing
liaisons.

### Member kinds

| kind | What it is | Can it be woken? |
|---|---|---|
| `session` | A DSH session, identified by its session id. | Yes — live or cold-resumed. |
| `user` | The human. The panel acts as this member. | No — recorded only. |
| `admin` | The room's built-in administrator. «总结今天»-style requests default to the first enabled `admin`. | No — recorded only, unless it is also a session id. |
| `bot` | Any non-session automated participant. | No — recorded only. |
| `liaison` | A reserved kind for an inter-room courier (see [Liaisons](#liaisons-r10)). | No — recorded only. |

**Both session-id shapes are real**: `session-<uuid>` and a bare `<uuid>`. Measured 2026-10-16
against the live runtime, `008bda70-4811-4349-a1a5-d6c6ff54d7d1` is

plugins.description: Nine DeepSeek Harness guard plugins in one installable set: secret-leak blocking, a per-session cost cap, auto-formatting after edits, and more.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-guard-pack

English | [中文](README_zh.md)

Nine guard plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) that catch the expensive mistakes coding agents make, installed with one command.

[![CI](https://github.com/acus9345/dsh-guard-pack/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/acus9345/dsh-guard-pack/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

Each guard watches tool calls before or after they run. When an agent is about to do something you'd regret, the call is stopped and the model is told why and what to do instead, so it usually fixes course in the same step.

| Plugin | What it stops | npm |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [dsh-block-secret-leaks](packages/dsh-block-secret-leaks) | Reading `.env` and key files, printing or uploading secrets, committing them, hardcoding them in source. Redacts any that reach tool output. **New.** | [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-block-secret-leaks)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-block-secret-leaks) |
| [dsh-session-cost-cap](packages/dsh-session-cost-cap) | A session (with its subagents) spending more than you set. Warns the model first, then asks you before each tool call. **New.** | [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-session-cost-cap)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-cost-cap) |
| [dsh-format-after-edit](packages/dsh-format-after-edit) | Unformatted code. Runs Prettier, Biome, dprint, Ruff, Black, gofmt, rustfmt or clang-format on every edited file. **New.** | [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-format-after-edit)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-format-after-edit) |
| [dsh-protect-tests](https://github.com/acus9345/dsh-protect-tests) | Edits that make tests pass by testing less: `.skip`, deleted assertions, `expect(true)`. | [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-protect-tests)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-protect-tests) |
| [dsh-block-placeholder-edits](https://github.com/acus9345/dsh-block-placeholder-edits) | `// ... existing code ...` written over real code. | [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-block-placeholder-edits)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-block-placeholder-edits) |
| [dsh-protect-generated-files](https://github.com/acus9345/dsh-protect-generated-files) | Hand edits to lockfiles and generated code. | [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-protect-generated-files)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-protect-generated-files) |
| [dsh-enforce-package-manager](https://github.com/acus9345/dsh-enforce-package-manager) | `npm install` in a pnpm repo, `pip install` in a uv project. | [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-enforce-package-manager)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-enforce-package-manager) |
| [dsh-block-hanging-commands](https://github.com/acus9345/dsh-block-hanging-commands) | Commands that wait for input or never exit: editors, REPLs, dev servers, `git commit` without `-m`. | [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-block-hanging-commands)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-block-hanging-commands) |
| [dsh-load-agent-rules](https://github.com/acus9345/dsh-load-agent-rules) | Ignoring the Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf and Cline rule files your repo already has. | [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-load-agent-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-load-agent-rules) |

## Install all of them

With DSH installed and `dsh` on your PATH:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/acus9345/dsh-guard-pack
cd dsh-guard-pack
node scripts/install.mjs
```

That adds all nine to the `web` profile (the browser UI you start with `dsh web`). Options:

```sh
node scripts/install.mjs --profile headless --profile web   # several profiles
node scripts/install.mjs --only secret,cost,format          # some of them
node scripts/install.mjs --remove                           # take them out again
node scripts/install.mjs --dry-run                          # print the commands only
```

Or skip the clone and paste one of these:

```sh
# bash / zsh
for p in dsh-block-secret-leaks dsh-session-cost-cap dsh-format-after-edit dsh-protect-tests dsh-block-placeholder-edits dsh-protect-generated-files dsh-enforce-package-manager dsh-block-hanging-commands dsh-load-agent-rules; do dsh plugin --profile web add "$p"; done
```

```powershell
# PowerShell
"dsh-block-secret-leaks","dsh-session-cost-cap","dsh-format-after-edit","dsh-protect-tests","dsh-block-placeholder-edits","dsh-protect-generated-files","dsh-enforce-package-manager","dsh-block-hanging-commands","dsh-load-agent-rules" | ForEach-Object { dsh plugin --profile web add $_ }
```

Every plugin works with no configuration. To change one, open **Plugins** in DSH's sidebar and click it, or see its README.

## Repository layout

The three new plugins live here as npm workspaces. The other six have their own repositories, linked above.

```
packages/
  dsh-block-secret-leaks/
  dsh-session-cost-cap/
  dsh-format-after-edit/
e2e/                     end-to-end tests that run the real dsh with a scripted model
scripts/install.mjs
```

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm test            # unit tests for every package
npm run test:e2e    # real dsh runs against a scripted local model, no API key needed
```

The end-to-end tests include a `dsh plugin add` install, which needs `pnpm` on your PATH.

To release a package, bump its version and `CHANGELOG.md`, then push a tag named `<package>-v<version>`, for example `dsh-session-cost-cap-v0.1.1`. The release workflow tests everything, publishes that package to npm with trusted publishing, and creates the GitHub release.

MIT licensed. Written by [acus9345](https://github.com/acus9345). Bug reports and ideas are welcome in the [issues](https://github.com/acus9345/dsh-guard-pack/issues).

plugins.description: Second-opinion review for DeepSeek Harness sessions: a restricted child session re-reads the Executor's work with read-only tools and delivers severity-ranked advice.
plugins.readme_text:
# @wweir/dsh-advisor

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

An automatic second opinion for DeepSeek Harness sessions.

On a configurable step rhythm, a **restricted sub-agent** re-reads the
Executor's recent work with read-only tools. Concrete defects are recorded and
delivered to the Executor's inbox; when there is nothing to point at, the
reviewer stays silent — silence is the normal outcome, not a failure.

The plugin never runs its own model loop: the review is a real child session,
so the host's turn/step machine, tool pipeline, streaming, cancellation and
persistence apply to it unchanged.

## What it does for you

- **Catches hallucinations.** The reviewer reads the actual files (read-only):
  changes claimed but not made, APIs that do not exist, values never written.
  The note points at the mismatch while the work is fresh; delivery is
  advisory, interrupting only as configured.
- **Keeps sessions on track.** At most one review every N completed steps
  (default 8), never concurrently — a step boundary that arrives mid-review
  waits for the next cadence instead of stacking reviews. A step is one model
  call plus its tools, so one cadence covers work inside a long turn and work
  spread across many short turns; `everySteps: 0` turns automatic review off.
  Drift is reported inside the running turn; idle sessions can be woken by
  severe findings (budgeted, severity-gated). Silence is reported as a result,
  not an error.
- **Bounded cost.** The reviewer's context is a compiled two-zone projection,
  never a copy of the Executor's. The prompt is capped by the operator's
  `maxContextTokens` (64K by default) **and** by the reviewer model's own
  window: the host preamble, the model's output reserve and a margin are
  subtracted first, and a route that cannot hold even a minimal review is
  refused with those numbers instead of overflowing into a host compaction.
  The check is as good as the route's advertisement: a route that does not
  report a window keeps the operator's cap, because that is the only number the
  plugin has.
  The zone after the boundary carries the work since the last review that
  concluded (a silent or finding outcome), with its evidence graded by whether
  the reviewer could re-obtain it: the Executor's visible claims travel, a tool
  call keeps its name and arguments (shell commands capped at 600 characters,
  edits at 2,000), a file read or search the reviewer can repeat becomes its
  path and size, a shell result its status, a few failure lines and the tail,
  and every other result — an edit, a tool error, `ls`, an MCP server, a
  subagent, a job — keeps its text. Every message line is capped at 4,000
  characters. The zone before the boundary is a trace of
  already-reviewed work, with tool-result bodies omitted — and the prompt says
  so, because omitted must not read as unexecuted. The Executor's reasoning is
  dropped: it is intent, not evidence. Earlier reviews' conclusions travel as a
  bounded block, so the reviewer does not re-investigate work already judged.
  The boundary line carries a nonce minted per review, so a phrase quoted inside
  the evidence cannot pose as it. A stable instruction prefix lets the provider
  cache hit across reviews (cache-read tokens are shown in the tab and billed
  at cache rates). Output is a single advice of at most 2K characters.

## Why

Most advisor plugins hand the transcript to one extra LLM call and inject
whatever comes back. This plugin makes the reviewer a **real child session with
its own read-only tools**, which buys four concrete things:

- **It verifies instead of guessing.** The reviewer opens the files the
  Executor actually touched, so a note points at a defect it looked at — not
  a pattern inferred from a transcript summary, which is all a
  transcript-only reviewer can ever offer.
- **The host's rules apply to the review itself.** Turn/step accounting, the
  tool pipeline, streaming, cancellation, persistence, and a real audit
  trail: the review is a session you can inspect, and its cost is reported
  usage, not an estimate.
- **Isolation is enforced, not promised.** One reviewer claim per process, a
  read-only tool surface, a protected-path guard deliberately stricter than
  the upstream advisor (workspace-root private keys and `.envrc` included),
  and no shared context with the Executor.
- **Delivery is accounted.** A **follow-up** note counts as delivered only when
  the host proves it was processed (that turn's model reply); an unconfirmed
  note is requeued, never silently dropped. A note steered into a running turn
  counts as delivered at the hand-off. Repetition is suppressed by finding
  identity plus similarity, with hash-based mutes.

## Install

The package is a Cordis plugin (`dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`) and is
published on npm with a provenance attestation, so it installs like any other
profile bundle:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @wweir/dsh-advisor
```

A development checkout can be linked instead (`dsh plugin … add /path/to/checkout`);
its deploy path is described in `docs/OPERATIONS.md`.

Then give it a model route. It is **disabled until a model is configured**, and
it never falls back to the Executor's model:

```yaml
- id: advisor
  name: '@wweir/dsh-advisor'
  config:
    enabled: true
    model:
      provider: opencode-go
      model: glm-5.3-flash
      reasoningEffort: low
    instructions: ''            # extra review instructions, appended to the prompt
    review:
      everySteps: 8             # minimum completed steps between two reviews (0 = off)
      timeoutMs: 180000         # wall-clock bound for one review
      maxContextTokens: 64000   # upper bound on the review prompt (the model's window can lower it)
      maxAdviceChars: 2000      # one advice body
      maxPending: 32            # queued, not-yet-delivered notes
    delivery:
      activeIdleSeverities: [concern, blocker]   # severities allowed to wake an idle Executor
    security:
      additionalProtectedPaths: []      # extra paths the reviewer may never read
```

A patch entry is **replaced, not merged**, per row id: an overlay that sets
only the extra instructions drops the model route, so the row loads **disabled**;
it fails loudly, with a validation error, only when the overlay also asks for
`enabled: true`.

## Behaviour worth knowing

- **Trigger** — one cadence: a completed *step*, i.e. one model call plus the
  tools it ran. Steps are the host's progress unit, so the same counter covers
  work inside a long turn (which crosses no reply boundary for dozens of steps)
  and work spread across many short turns; there is no second, reply-based
  interval that could disagree with it. A review starts once `everySteps` steps
  (default 8) have accrued since the previous one finished. The cursor moves
  when a review *finishes*, so a slow review cannot chain into the next one; the
  counter and cursor are absolute and persisted, so a reload continues the
  cadence instead of forgiving the steps that accrued since the last review. A
  fresh session is first reviewed after a full cadence, not immediately. The
  turn's final answer starts no review of its own: the steps that produced it
  already had their chance, so the tail of a session that stops mid-cadence is
  reviewed by the next steps that accrue. Sub-agent sessions (including the
  review children) are never reviewed. Turns this plugin opened itself are never
  reviewed either.
- **Review child limits** — one review is one bounded attempt. It may run at
  most five reads or searches; a further call is refused with the reason to
  conclude from the evidence it already has. At 70 % of `timeoutMs` it is
  steered to conclude, and silence stays a valid conclusion; at the deadline the
  child is cancelled and the attempt is recorded as a failure. A failed review
  does not advance the reviewed boundary, so its material is re-read by the next
  attempt, while the cadence cursor still moves, so a broken route is not
  retried once per step.
- **Delivery** — while the Executor is running the note is handed into the
  next step boundary; while it is idle the note may open
